name: Leyala
source: Leyala was abandoned as a baby and was raised by a foster family who did not treat her well. Despite this, she is a very compassionate woman who longs to have a family of her own. She is extremely intelligent; however, she often thinks with her emotions first and can be a little naïve. She also seems to love starting conversations in bed just as the person she's with is about to fall asleep.
